points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh immutable 0065953 archive: default CMake configure failed because FindHDF5 treated NO_MODULE_PATH as a component; configuration and build succeeded with HDF5_DIR=/opt/external/cfd_externals/install/cmake and CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_PREFER_CONFIG=ON in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256 processes). CTest registered no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:45–47 parses case/output/report level. Help :37 advertises --restart but no code parses or applies it; this is an unsupported required operation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated mesh, partition, IO, physics, and solver modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal wrapper/executable invocation found; trust policy does not permit external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON/CGNS-driven case path is source-supported, though no independent generality run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: 0065953 main.cpp:61–74 reads full CGNS mesh on every rank and retains it through the solver; :139 still uses it. Violates TASK.md:46,227 even with METIS and neighbor halos.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positive-state safeguards and exceptions are present; no independent stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: CTest registers no tests. The eight workspace packages and historical report pass read-only examiner checks, but physics and output-status failures remain.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable C++17 code, but backup source copies and no reproducible final-result package reduce hygiene.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
